instruction: Open Windows Explorer window 1, click the address bar, type \\DC01\smb_lab, and press Enter. Keep this Explorer window open.
expected_effect: Explorer window 1 displays \\DC01\smb_lab.

instruction: Open Windows Explorer window 2, click the address bar, type \\DC01\smb_lab, and press Enter. Keep this Explorer window open.
expected_effect: Explorer window 2 displays \\DC01\smb_lab.

instruction: In the Explorer window showing the SMB root, press Ctrl+Shift+N, type Project_Orion, and press Enter.
expected_effect: Project_Orion is created in the SMB share root.

instruction: In the Explorer window showing the SMB root, press Ctrl+Shift+N, type Shared_Reports, and press Enter.
expected_effect: Shared_Reports is created in the SMB share root.

instruction: In the Explorer window showing the SMB root, press Ctrl+Shift+N, type Team_Notes, and press Enter.

instruction: In the Explorer window showing the SMB root, press Ctrl+Shift+N, type Transfer, and press Enter.

instruction: In Explorer window 1, double-click Project_Orion.
expected_effect: Explorer window 1 displays Project_Orion.

instruction: In Explorer window 2, double-click Shared_Reports.
expected_effect: Explorer window 2 displays Shared_Reports.

instruction: In the Project_Orion Explorer window, right-click an empty area, choose New > Folder, type Documents, and press Enter.

instruction: In the Project_Orion Explorer window, right-click an empty area, choose New > Folder, type Working, and press Enter.

instruction: In the Project_Orion Explorer window, right-click an empty area, choose New > Folder, type Archive, and press Enter.
